Ile kosztuje boisko do panny?: How much does a panna court cost?
Konstrukcje kosztują od 36 000 zł netto: Structures range from PLN 36,000 excluding VAT (Panna Cage 90) to PLN 100,000 excluding VAT (Street Arena 15). With a concrete slab and painting, Panna Play, for example, starts at PLN 51,000 excluding VAT. Installation, transport and site preparation are quoted after reviewing site photos.
Co zawiera cena konstrukcji?: What is included in the structure price?
Konstrukcję z bramkami w podstawowej kon: The structure with goals in the basic configuration and standard colour. Surfacing, installation, transport and graphics are excluded. The price with surface adds a 12 cm concrete slab with sub-base and single-colour painting.
Czym różni się panna od street footballu: How does panna differ from 3v3 street football?
Panna to gra 1 na 1 na małej, zamkniętej: Panna is 1v1 play in a small enclosed arena: technique and playing the ball between an opponent's legs matter. 3v3 street football is fast team play on a larger boarded court, represented in our range by the 15 × 10 m Street Arena 15.
Ile miejsca potrzebuje boisko do panny?: How much space does a panna court need?
Najmniejsze areny mają około 5 m średnic: The smallest arenas are approximately 5 m in diameter, and the surface area with a 10% allowance starts at 21.5 m² (Panna Ring). A 3v3 court measures 15 × 10 m. Additional safety space is needed around it. Check your site dimensions in the “Will it fit?” planner.
Która arena jest najlepsza dla szkoły al: Which arena is best for a school or residential community?
Do szkół i osiedli najczęściej polecam P: For schools and residential communities I usually recommend Panna Cage 90 (low and visually open) and Panna Play; for municipalities and parks, Panna Octa; for clubs and academies, Panna Cage 180 with a higher enclosure. The final choice depends on the site and age group.
Czy mogę zobaczyć model, zanim zamówię?: Can I see the model before ordering?
Tak. Każdy model obejrzysz w 3D, a w Stu: Yes. View each model in 3D, then choose the frame colour, surface and pattern in Studio and see the price immediately. Download the design as a PDF project sheet.
Jak długo wytrzyma arena?: How long will the arena last?
Panna Ring stoi na Orliku OSiR w Grodzis: Panna Ring has stood at the OSiR Orlik facility in Grodzisk Mazowiecki for 10 years without damage. I provide a 12-month warranty and ongoing support after handover.

Tak. Arena mobilna eventowa: wynajem i s: Yes. Mobile event arena: rental and sale, from PLN 27,000 excluding VAT. It has been used at tournaments, championships and brand activations.
